name: Matsumoto Yushi-Seiyaku Co., Ltd.
summary: Matsumoto Yushi-Seiyaku Co., Ltd. produces and supplies surface active agents and polymers in Japan, China, Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. It offers spin finishes for extrusion spinning, textile spinning, and functional surface treatment of fibers; sizing chemicals for weaving; knitting and weaving lubricants; scouring agents and detergents; and dyeing and processing auxiliaries, including moisture management, antistatic, water-repellent finishing, anti-soiling, flame-retardants, and anti-light-fastness agents.
